description: This Java source file defines the ContentMapFacade class, which implements a Map interface for content management within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to access content fields, links, subcontent, metadata, and rendering functionalities, encapsulating content-related operations and data retrieval logic.

classes.name: ContentMapFacade
classes.description: Main class implementing a Map interface for content management, providing access to content fields, links, subcontent, metadata, and rendering.

classes.name: Content
classes.description: Inner class representing content object, providing access to content data by key.

classes.name: SubContent
classes.description: Inner class managing subcontent list and filters, providing access to subcontent content objects.

classes.name: MetaData
classes.description: Inner class for accessing content metadata by predicate ID.

classes.name: DataResource
classes.description: Inner class for accessing data resource related objects and rendering.

classes.name: AbstractInfo
classes.description: Abstract base class for info objects, implementing Map with unimplemented methods.

methods.name: setRenderFlag
methods.description: Sets whether content rendering is allowed.

methods.name: setIsDecorated
methods.description: Sets whether the content is decorated.

methods.name: setSortOrder
methods.description: Sets the sort order for subcontent.

methods.name: setMapKeyFilter
methods.description: Sets the filter for map keys.

methods.name: setStatusFilter
methods.description: Sets the status filter for subcontent.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves content data, link, subcontent, metadata, or renders content based on key.

methods.name: renderThis
methods.description: Renders the content as text, considering decoration and recursion flags.
